scenarios.title: Kicks for the Hospital
scenarios.text: The club runs a kick-a-thon for a children's hospital, and you're the main event: a donation for every kick you make in an hour.

choices.label: Kick for the full hour
choices.result: You kick for the full hour without stopping. Your leg is jelly, and the total is the biggest the hospital has ever seen.

choices.label: Let the kids kick too
choices.result: You give every kid a turn at the tee. The donations drop; the photos are the best of the year.

choices.label: Recruit the specialists
choices.result: You talk the punter and snapper into joining. It turns into a contest, and the crowd doubles.

scenarios.title: The Night Before Your Debut
scenarios.text: The night before your first regular-season game, and your phone won't stop buzzing.

choices.label: Phone off, early night
choices.result: You turn the phone off at eight and read until you fall asleep.

choices.label: Answer the important ones
choices.result: You answer {parent} and {best_friend} and ignore the rest. Their messages are the right ones.

choices.label: Go over the plan once more
choices.result: You go over the special teams plan one more time, then sleep. You walk in calm.

scenarios.title: The Debut Week Interview
scenarios.text: The national broadcast crew wants five minutes with the rookie kicker before the game.

choices.label: Tell your story
choices.result: You tell them about kicking in your backyard with {parent}. It makes the broadcast.

choices.label: Keep it short
choices.result: You keep it to football and keep it short. The crew thanks you; nothing makes air.

choices.label: Talk about the unit
choices.result: You talk about the snapper and the holder. The specialists' group chat is very happy.

scenarios.title: The Team Photo
scenarios.text: The team photo, and you're in the back row next to a lineman who has never learned your name.

choices.label: Introduce yourself, again
choices.result: You introduce yourself to the lineman, again. He laughs, and from then on he calls you by name.

choices.label: Smile and wait
choices.result: You smile, wait for the flash and go back to the locker room.

choices.label: Organize the specialists' photo
choices.result: You organize a specialists-only photo afterward. It ends up framed in the facility.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Payday Dinner
scenarios.text: Your rookie class decides to celebrate your first full paycheck together, at a restaurant you can't pronounce.

choices.label: Go and enjoy it
choices.result: You go and enjoy it. The bill is absurd, and the night is worth it.

choices.label: Suggest a cheaper place
choices.result: You suggest a cheaper place with the same view. Half the class comes, and the rest think you're cheap.

choices.label: Skip it
choices.result: You skip it and order in. Your account is happier than you are.

scenarios.title: The Trainer's Warning
scenarios.text: A trainer quietly warns you about the supplements a veteran keeps recommending to the rookies.

choices.label: Thank the trainer and stop
choices.result: You thank the trainer and stop taking anything the club didn't approve. You sleep better knowing.

choices.label: Tell the other rookies
choices.result: You tell the other rookies what the trainer said. Two of them throw theirs out that night.

choices.label: Ask no questions
choices.result: You decide you never took anything anyway and move on. You're fine, and you never ask what the others are taking.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Who Talks Too Much
scenarios.text: A rookie in your class keeps leaking locker room jokes online, and the veterans are getting angry.

choices.label: Talk to him
choices.result: You talk to him privately. He didn't know it was a big deal. He stops.

choices.label: Tell a veteran
choices.result: You tell a veteran you trust, who handles it. It's quieter than you'd have managed.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: You stay out of it. The veterans handle it, loudly.

scenarios.title: The Specialist Meeting Room
scenarios.text: The specialists' meeting room is the size of a closet, and three of you share it with a broken projector.

choices.label: Ask for a better room
choices.result: You ask the operations staff for a real room. You get one, and the punter calls you a hero.

choices.label: Make the closet work
choices.result: You bring snacks and a better extension cord. The closet becomes the best room in the building.

choices.label: Use the film room at night
choices.result: You use the main film room after hours. It's empty, and you learn more.

scenarios.title: The Wrong Bus
scenarios.text: You get on the wrong team bus after a road practice and end up at the airport alone.

choices.label: Laugh about it
choices.result: You laugh about it in the group chat. The nickname sticks for a season.

choices.label: Call the travel staff
choices.result: You call the travel staff, who send a car. You're back before anyone notices.

choices.label: Wait at the airport
choices.result: You wait at the airport with a book until the team arrives. Nobody believes your story.

scenarios.title: Your First Billboard
scenarios.text: Your face goes up on a billboard by the highway, and you drive past it twice.

choices.label: Send a photo home
choices.result: You send a photo to {parent}, who drives three hours to see it in person.

choices.label: Avoid that highway
choices.result: You take a different route to practice. It's too strange to look at.

choices.label: Use it as motivation
choices.result: You tell yourself you have to earn it. You kick an extra hundred balls that week.

scenarios.title: The Veteran's Retirement Party
scenarios.text: A veteran you barely know retires, and you're expected at the party.

choices.label: Go and listen
choices.result: You go and listen to the stories. You learn more about the league in one night than in a month.

choices.label: Stop by briefly
choices.result: You stop by for half an hour and congratulate him. Then you go home.

choices.label: Give a toast
choices.result: You give a short toast on behalf of the rookies. The veteran shakes your hand for a long time.

scenarios.title: The Mentor Who Leaves
scenarios.text: The veteran who took you under his wing is traded to another club.

choices.label: Help him pack
choices.result: You help him pack his locker and keep in touch every week.

choices.label: Take his place in the room
choices.result: You start doing for the next rookie what he did for you.

choices.label: Kick harder
choices.result: You turn the sting into extra work. It helps, a little.

scenarios.title: The Agent's Other Rookies
scenarios.text: Your agent has four rookie clients, and you can tell you're fourth.

choices.label: Ask for a plan
choices.result: You ask your agent for a written plan and a monthly call. You get both.

choices.label: Make yourself first
choices.result: You decide to be the client who's impossible to ignore, and kick like it.

choices.label: Let it ride
choices.result: You let it ride. Rookie contracts are fixed anyway.
